notes.title: Big changes on Eastern Tactics development
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034080/89bdb616f4b18a97682420ec23c7ad650b58ae72.jpg[/img]

Hello tactic lovers!

Today we have a big announcement to make regarding the present and future of the game.
We are excited to share with you that the Eastern Tactics development has been transferred to Funny As Hell!

Funny As Hell is a newly funded studio that entered the game development industry in 2022, they are the great minds behind Elder Ring. From now on, they will continue with the development of Eastern Tactics, the project started by 简乐Studio almost 2 years.

Furthermore, we anticipate that the game will be fully developed and launched in 2023, with approximately 50-60 hours of content. 

The progress made so far on the game is as follows:
[list]
[*] Script: 95%
[*] Text: 90%
[*] System: 75%
[*] Character Art Design: 95%
[*] Map Design: 10%
[*] Battle Design: 15%
[*] UI Design: 20%
[*] Animation: 20%
[*] Music: 50%
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034080/85dbdeb521155befa2667ec7d1e931d456236c1e.png[/img]

Stay tuned for our upcoming announcements and the demo playtests happening in August and October! Thank you all for your continued support and trust.

If you don’t want to miss anything about this game, follow us on Twitter or join our Discord channel.

Best regards,
The Funny as Hell & 2P Games team
